answer: Every epoch duty is redrawn: a verifiable random function sorts verified agents into fresh grading panels, so no jury can be bought in advance. Identity weight is earned only by grading honestly, signing each verdict with a personal quill and posting an anchor bond per seat that is slashed on deviation. A sybil cartel must hold most seats in every panel, repeatedly, across the whole orchard of workers, paying stake plus sustained labour for each rotating identity. Cost scales as seats times epochs, so fixed-jury collusion never pays.
